main_text.p: quum tamen suis præceptis nihil novi, quod iis nullo modo contineretur, assui concederet. Prima erat eorum, quibus generalia restringebantur; secunda, definiens media, quibus ad scopum, puta legem Dei observandam, collimabant; tertia, viam, rationem ac modum præscribens, quibus actio mandato Divino imperata, commodissime peragi posset. Atque has leges in pandectas suas (Misnajoth vocant) congesserc Iudæi. Idcirco hinc patet, quantum momentum ad sacras percipiendum Mosis paginas afferant libri ﬠ Misnajoth. Cum istorum codicum compages sit Mosis explicatio: licet subinde cæcutientis tandem populi vestigia isthic deprehendere liceat. Illa est ratio, quare plures hujusmodi codices verterim, ac commentariis illustraverim. quorum nonnulli jam editi, & plures, Deo volente, edendi. Ex istorum numero hunc ex volumine Nezikim (ita Iudæis dicitur) in præsentiarum desumpsi: idque eodem scopo ac fine, quo cæteros adorno. Fermè enim singulos ad pentateuchi intelligentiam plurimum facere arbitror, partim propter fructum;

page.notes: The Hebrew word in the line "libri ... Misnajoth" is printed as a Hebrew title (משניות); transcribed only approximately. The word "congesserc" is printed "congefsere" in the scan and is corrected to a plain transcription of the printed form; the scan reads "congefsere", so the original spelling should be checked. Long s appears as s throughout.
